365:t_1:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

365:t_1:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「...So $$オルソン$$ is on $$翠の地球$$.」

365:t_1:6.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Who's this $$オルソン$$ guy?」

365:t_1:7.en:
$$桂$$
「He's my longtime partner. And he's the other half of our $$特異点$$.」

365:t_1:10.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Mathematically, it denotes an object excluded from a definition. In the multiverse, it denotes a starting point or knot in spacetime distortions or intersections.」

365:t_1:11.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hey... Tin Can. If you're going to explain it, make it understandable.」

365:t_1:12.en:
$$モーム$$
「Simply put, it's a person or object at the starting point of a $$時空震動$$.」

365:t_1:13.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Thanks, $$モーム$$. You're both robots, but you're built better than Tin Can.」

365:t_1:14.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$モーム$$ is good at cooking and laundry, too.」

365:t_1:15.en:
$$桂$$
「And she can nurse people and maintain machines.」

365:t_1:17.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit is a $$パイロット支援啓発インターフェイス$$. Such functions are outside my mission parameters.」

365:t_1:18.en:
$$ガロード$$
「But $$モーム$$ helps $$桂$$ out in all sorts of ways, too.」

365:t_1:19.en:
$$パーラ$$
「That's right. She comforts him when he's down, and cheers him on when he's in trouble.」

365:t_1:21.en:
$$モーム$$
「I'm very happy to hear you say that, $$桂$$.」

365:t_1:23.en:
$$レド$$
「You've lost completely, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

365:t_1:25.en:
$$ティファ$$
「I think $$チェインバー#pilot$$ has his own good points, too.」

365:t_1:26.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Thank you for your accurate observation, $$ティファ$$.」

365:t_1:27.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Well, he's gotten more human since we picked him up on $$翠の地球$$.」

365:t_1:28.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I disagree with that observation. This unit is solely an interface, and has no need for humanity.」

365:t_1:31.en:
$$宗介$$
「...I am, watching $$レド$$ and $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

365:t_1:33.en:
$$宗介$$
「There's no need to worry. $$アル$$'s will lives on within me.」

365:t_1:34.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Though he'd probably demand an explanation right away if I said something so sentimental.」

365:t_1:35.en:
$n
「But that really does happen. Someone can live on in another person's heart...」

365:t_1:36.en:
$$桂$$
「...Basically, $$オルソン$$ and I were there when the $$時空震動弾$$ that started this multiverse went off, so we became $$特異点$$s.」

365:t_1:37.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I've heard $$特異点$$s are essential to repairing spacetime.」

365:t_1:38.en:
$$レド$$
「Then can you restore the multiverse to its original state... separate parallel worlds?」

365:t_1:40.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What does that mean? I heard Colonel $$シャア$$ fixed the $$時の牢獄$$ after becoming the $$特異点$$ of the $$新世時空震動$$.」

365:t_1:41.en:
$$桂$$
「The structure of $$蒼の地球$$'s case was simple.」

365:t_1:42.en:
$$桂$$
「But the phases of the current multiverse, including worlds besides ours, are too tangled. We're told repair is impossible.」

365:t_1:43.en:
$$桂$$
「If we could find the point where that complex knot converges, it might be possible...」

365:t_1:44.en:
$$桂$$
「But they say there's a risk that one mistake could destroy every parallel world.」

365:t_1:47.en:
$$エイミー$$
「No. Everyone in the fleet is used to life on $$翠の地球$$, and $$レド$$ and I are living in this world, too.」

365:t_1:48.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Sure... people like $$サイデリアル$$ are around, so everything isn't going perfectly. But even so... I've come to love this world.」

365:t_1:49.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah. I'd be in a bind if someone said the world was going back to normal now.」

365:t_1:50.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Maybe it's like how everyone accepts that time can't be turned back.」

365:t_1:51.en:
$$ティファ$$
「People overcome farewells and regrets and move forward... I think it's the same for the multiverse.」

365:t_1:52.en:
$$桂$$
「Thanks, everyone. As the guy who set off the $$時空震動弾$$, hearing that makes me feel a little better.」

365:t_1:54.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Then why are those $$サイデリアル$$ guys keeping this $$オルソン$$ fellow prisoner?」

365:t_1:55.en:
$$桂$$
「I helped Dr. $$トライア$$ with her experiments, too. He's probably the subject of their super-dimensional physics research.」

365:t_1:56.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Maybe they're using him for something that extracts $$次元力$$.」

365:t_1:57.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Then we've got to hurry and rescue him...!」

365:t_1:58.en:
$$桂$$
「Don't rush. First we have to descend to $$翠の地球$$.」

365:t_1:59.en:
$$レド$$
「I heard the plan is for the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ to draw away the defense force, while the force led by the $$マクロス・クォーター$$ descends at once.」

365:t_1:60.en:
$$桂$$
「Then, while the $$クォーター$$ distracts them, the infiltration team rescues $$オルソン$$ from the base.」

365:t_1:62.en:
$$桂$$
「$$特異点$$ or not, we can't let $$サイデリアル$$ keep using $$オルソン$$ as their toy.」

365:t_1:66.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Briefing Room～

365:t_1:67.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Captain $$クルーゾー$$ and I will command the infiltration team.」

365:t_1:68.en:
$n
「Lieutenant $$クルーゾー$$... have you been promoted?」

365:t_1:69.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「$$ミスリル$$'s personnel have been greatly reduced. Even at a time like this, we reassessed ranks to keep the structure in order.」

365:t_1:70.en:
$$マオ$$
「So I've been promoted to Ensign, too... an officer, if you please.」

365:t_1:74.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You bet! As of today, I'm a Master Sergeant, too.」

365:t_1:77.en:
$n
「Sorry. When I think of $$アルト$$ and $$レド$$ being ensigns...」

365:t_1:78.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Tch... $$ミスリル$$'s field personnel sure have low ranks compared to other organizations...」

365:t_1:79.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Don't complain, Master Sergeant. I expect work worthy of your rank.」

365:t_1:81.en:
$$宗介$$
「Whatever he says, it seems he's happy about the promotion.」

365:t_1:82.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Aren't you jealous of your colleagues moving up, $$宗介$$?」

365:t_1:83.en:
$$宗介$$
「A Master Sergeant has to coordinate personnel in the field. $$クルツ$$ is suited to that kind of work.」

365:t_1:84.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Well... that role does suit him.」

365:t_1:85.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Hey, $$クロウ$$... I absolutely refuse to join the Short Straw Alliance.」
